desc: The ODIN Works Enduro performs as the name implies, a do it all Suppressor for your shooting needs. The Enduro is a feature packed modular suppressor design that has industry leading sound properties. Simply put, this can sounds amazing. You can shoot 338 Lapua through it in its full configuration or shorten it all the way down and shoot 22 Long Rifle through it. For pistol calibers, the Enduro is rated for 9mm and comes with a 9mm endcap that will work with all other calibers. The Enduro comes with the body and two baffles made from heat treated stainless steel. It also comes with five 7075 hard anodized aluminum baffles for the shooter to use in whatever length fits their needs. The modular Enduro features different caliber endcaps, also 7075 aluminum, that can be switched out to match your gun's caliber. At the other end, the Enduro has included thread adapters that can be changed to fit 1/2-28 and 5/8-24 threaded barrels.
